name: bangers
description: Turn one idea into scroll-stopping content across every platform. BANGERS is a full social-media content studio — scripts, threads, carousels, newsletters, hooks, titles, and edit sheets for YouTube, Shorts, TikTok, Instagram, X, LinkedIn, Substack, Bluesky, and Facebook Groups — built on the reverse-engineered playbooks of Fireship, Matt Pocock, Theo, and ThePrimeagen, and adaptable to any creator's niche.
